mentions.name: digs.fm
mentions.description: This is a music tracking and discovery platform, like Goodreads but for music, that lets users organize albums they want to listen to, albums they have listened to, and albums they liked, and see the music discoveries of other users they follow.
mentions.problem: The author needed a better way to organize the albums they want to listen to, have listened to, and liked, and to discover new music through the finds of people with taste they trust.
mentions.audience: The author, as a deliberate music listener looking to track and organize albums and discover new music through people whose taste they trust.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://digs.fm - like Goodreads, but for music.

As someone who's constantly on the look for new music to discover and being very deliberate about the things I'm listening, I needed a better way to organize the albums I want to listen to, listened and liked. And also I would like to see the discoveries of other folks who I know I like.
mentions.author: digs-fm
